title: Nothing the pixels receive can carry Space intents, and every gtag call passes the guard

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: createspace.offer sends intents to GA4 (lib/create-space/signal.ts:74 through app/api/create-space/signal/route.ts) because intents is not a denied key in lib/analytics/sanitize.ts:102-127, contradicting lib/spaces/provision.ts:282-283. lib/how/brief-tracker.ts:66 calls gtag without pixelSafeProps. Both carry business goals, not wellness data, today; the rule is no persona data to pixels, so the guard should not depend on that.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
